rich2021SourceExamples: Original 2021 Grade5 U07:L08 classifies triangles by BOTH side-length equality and angle measure, using physical original triangle cards. Since internal angles total180 degrees, a triangle cannot have two right or two obtuse angles.

Warm-up Estimation Exploration Angle Measure shows an original figure whose numeric answer depends on measuring the printed angle; student low/about-right/high estimates are not falsely replaced by a fabricated exact angle.

Activity1 The Right Fit presents a six-cell classification grid: all different, exactly two equal, all three equal side lengths versus has90, has>90, all<90 angles. Students select original image cards or explain a combination impossible; an equilateral triangle is acute, never right or obtuse.

Activity2 All, Some, None uses right triangles from the first activity and asks pupils to formulate generally valid statements about their side-length classifications. A right isosceles triangle is possible; not all right triangles are isosceles and none has a second right angle.

Existing geometrical teaching explanations remain optional extensions; source card layouts, drawings, student explanations and publisher Cool-down require teacher inspection. Selected choices only check fixed triangle-property implications.
limitations: Publisher original cards/coordinate diagrams not independently certified
Original teacher-gated Cool-down distinct from independently authored alternative; teacher scores shape classifications and patterns
